name: Monash University
summary: Melbourne university with Clayton and Caulfield campuses; Arts, Business, Science and Engineering degrees starting in February or July.

ib.text: Each course sets an IB total for 2027 entry: Arts 26, Business 27, Science 28, Engineering 30. English at SL 4 or HL 3 is required, and some courses list maths or science prerequisites.

apply.via: Direct to Monash (VTAC only for IB in Australia/NZ)

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science
programmes.about: A flexible three-year science degree with majors in biological, biomedical, earth and environmental, mathematical and computational, and physical and chemical sciences, taught at Clayton.
programmes.ib: 2027 entry needs 28 IB points, with English at SL 4 or HL 3.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your IB total against the 2027 entry score for the course.

flagshipSource.title: Bachelor of Science: majors across five science areas, drawing on the University's depth of expertise

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours)
programmes.about: A four-year honours engineering degree with specialisations that include aerospace, biomedical, chemical and civil; the whole academic record is considered in selection.
programmes.ib: 2027 entry needs 30 IB points. Prerequisite subjects differ by engineering specialisation; check the course page.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your IB total against the 2027 entry score; the course uses the entire academic record.

flagshipSource.title: Monash Engineering: course page presents the degree as study with world-class research facilities and academics

faculties.name: Arts
faculties.line: Bachelor of Arts: 2027 entry needs IB 26 plus English.

faculties.name: Business and Economics
faculties.line: Bachelor of Business (Caulfield): 2027 entry needs IB 27; starts February or July.

faculties.name: Engineering
faculties.line: Engineering (Honours): IB 30 for 2027; prerequisites vary by specialisation.

faculties.name: Science
faculties.line: Bachelor of Science: IB 28 for 2027, with English at SL 4 or HL 3.

notes: IB students outside Australia and New Zealand apply directly to Monash for both the February and July intakes; VTAC is for IB students in Australia or NZ.
No closing date is published for international applicants; some courses close months to a year before they start, so apply early.
Entry scores are shown per course for the 2027 intake; the whole record is read for Engineering.
